envelope.description: Add the input and output checks to executeTool

body.title: Add the input and output checks to executeTool
body.summary: In src/daemon/tools/executor.ts, for a tool that declares an outputSchema, validate the input against inputSchema before running (failure kind rejected naming the fields, tool not run) and the data against outputSchema after a successful run (schema-mismatch, data dropped, output replaced by the message, failure.original keeps the tool output truncated at a module constant). A thrown tool error also carries failure kind rejected. A tool with no outputSchema, a failed result and the existing unknown-tool path behave exactly as before; a schema ajv cannot compile is a rejected failure logged at error level.
acceptanceChecks: a tool without outputSchema returns exactly what it returned before and its input is not validated
data that does not fit returns schema-mismatch with the failing paths named and the unmatched data not passed on
success without data on a schematized tool returns schema-mismatch
the validator for a schema object is compiled once across calls
src/agent/read-only-tool-loop.ts:78 still receives output, success and error unchanged through the real executeTool
